verdict.rationale: Unstructured is a document-processing workflow platform, so event-driven automation is a fair axis. The evidence only shows workflows that are created and run on demand through the UI, SDK, or REST API ("Trigger runs" means manually starting a job). Nothing shows user-defined rules, schedules, or event triggers such as new files arriving in a source connector. The automatic per-page routing between partition strategies is built-in processing logic, not user-defined rules triggering actions.
